Map keywords to specific pages and content pieces across the website

Ensure the site is fully crawlable, indexable, and technically sound at all times



4) Content SEO & Optimization

Work with content writers to produce SEO-optimized blog posts, landing pages, and product pages

Audit existing content and provide optimization recommendations to improve rankings

Build and maintain a content calendar aligned with SEO opportunities and seasonal trends

Refresh and update underperforming content to improve rankings and organic traffic

Ensure all published content meets on-page SEO standards before going live



5) Link Building & Off-Page SEO

Develop and execute white-hat link building strategies to grow domain authority

Identify and pursue guest posting, digital PR, and outreach opportunities

Monitor the backlink profile using tools such as Ahrefs or SEMrush and disavow toxic links

Build relationships with relevant websites and publishers for ongoing link acquisition

Track referring domains, new backlinks, and authority growth over time



6) Reporting & Analytics

Track and report on key SEO metrics weekly and monthly: organic traffic, keyword rankings, impressions, CTR, and conversions

Use Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, and SEO tools to measure performance

Provide clear, data-backed reports with insights and prioritized action items

Monitor algorithm updates and assess their impact on rankings and traffic



Requirements

Proven experience in SEO with measurable results in organic traffic and keyword ranking improvements

Strong proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, Screaming Frog, and Google Search Console

Solid understanding of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO best practices

Experience performing technical SEO audits and resolving site health issues

Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4) and the ability to interpret organic traffic data

Strong understanding of search intent and how to align content to meet user needs

Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities

Up-to-date knowledge of Google algorithm updates and their implications

Nice to Have

Experience with eCommerce SEO including product page and category page optimization

Familiarity with WordPress, Shopify, or other CMS platforms for implementing on-page changes

Experience with local SEO including Google Business Profile optimization

Basic understanding of HTML/CSS for implementing technical SEO recommendations directly

Content writing or editing experience with an SEO focus

Performance Expectations (Important)

Consistently improve organic keyword rankings and grow organic traffic month over month

Maintain a technically clean, well-optimized website with no major crawl or indexation issues

Deliver a steady pipeline of quality backlinks through ethical, white-hat outreach

Produce timely SEO reports with clear performance data and prioritized recommendations

Stay ahead of algorithm changes and proactively adjust strategy as needed

Provide clear communication and measurable progress toward agreed SEO goals



To Apply, Please Send

1. Your resume

2. Portfolio or case studies showing SEO results — include before/after traffic data, ranking improvements, or domain authority growth

3. List the SEO tools you use regularly and your proficiency level with each

4. Brief overview of your link building approach and examples of campaigns you have run

5. Your internet speed (MBPS)



Important

Please apply only if you have:

Proven, hands-on SEO experience with real, documented results

Strong technical SEO knowledge — not just content-level optimization

Experience with industry-standard SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, GSC, Screaming Frog)

title: Photo Editior
description:
JOB TITLE: E-Commerce Product Photo Editor — Color Correction & Retouching

Type: One-Time Project · Fixed-Price · Remote



ABOUT THE PROJECT

We have a batch of product photos (under 1,000 images) that need professional editing before they go live on our e-commerce store. We need every image to look polished, on-brand, and visually consistent — meaning uniform color grading, matched tones, corrected exposure, and a clean finish across the entire set. No image should look out of place when placed next to another.

The exact image count will be confirmed at project start. All work is fixed-price at $250 total for the full batch, paid upon delivery and approval.



TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS



Canvas Size: 2048 × 2048 px

Max File Size: Under 500 KB per file

Color Mode: sRGB

Resolution: 72 DPI (web-optimized)





DELIVERABLES PER IMAGE (2 versions)

Version 1 — PNG with Transparent Background

Clean cutout, product only, no background. Edges must be precise — no fringing, halos, or rough selections.

Version 2 — JPEG with White Background

Pure white (#FFFFFF) background, optimized compression to stay under 500 KB without sacrificing visible quality.



WHAT WE NEED DONE



Scale and position every product consistently within the 2048×2048 frame

Color correct and color match all images so tone, white balance, and saturation are uniform across the full batch

Retouch any imperfections — dust, reflections, uneven lighting, or blemishes on the product

Background removal (PNG) with clean, professional edges — not auto-select quality

Flatten to white (JPEG) with proper file compression to stay under 500 KB

Deliver a cohesive, catalog-ready set where every image looks like it belongs together





YOU'RE THE RIGHT FIT IF...



You have proven experience editing product photos for e-commerce (Shopify, Amazon, Etsy, etc.)

You work in Photoshop, Lightroom, or equivalent professional tools

You have a sharp eye for color consistency and can match tones across an entire batch

Your background removal work is clean at a professional standard — pen tool or equivalent, not magic wand

You're comfortable with a fixed-price arrangement and can give a realistic turnaround estimate before starting

You communicate proactively and deliver organized, properly named files on time





BUDGET

$250 USD fixed for the full batch (under 1,000 images). This works out to roughly $0.25–$0.50 per image depending on final count — a fair rate for experienced editors based in the Philippines. Payment upon delivery and client approval.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:



3–5 portfolio samples of past product photo editing (before/after preferred)

Your estimated turnaround time for a batch of this size

A brief note on your workflow and tools



Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

A real seat at an established agency. A growing Australian digital agency with a real client book — you'll own multiple Australian SME accounts across varied industries, not stuck on one.

Long-term and stable. Full-time, ongoing, with a clear path to coordinator or senior as the agency grows.



Variety of clients and industries. Multiple parallel accounts, varied verticals, real briefs — you'll deepen your craft fast.



A small, high-trust team. Agency director, design team, build team, and you running the campaigns. No layers, no committees, no internal politics.





The brief



A growing Australian digital marketing agency is hiring a full-time Digital Marketing Campaign Manager to join the team remotely from the Philippines.



You plan the campaign, execute across paid and organic channels, report what worked and what didn't, and talk the client through it — calmly, in clear English, on camera. Campaigns span SEO, Google Ads, and social (paid and organic) across
, Instagram, and LinkedIn. You are the person the agency director hands a client to and trusts to deliver.



If you are a deep specialist in one channel who'd rather not be in front of a client — this role is not for you.





The team you'll work with



You'll sit alongside the agency director (who handles sales and overall direction), the agency's design team (creative and ad assets), the build team (web and tech), and a small group of specialist partners. A small, capable, Melbourne-anchored agency — and you as the strategy-and-execution lead on the campaigns you run.





What you'll do



01 — Strategy. Develop integrated campaign plans spanning SEO, Google Ads,
, and social — paid and organic, across
, Instagram, LinkedIn and other channels. Run competitor analysis and translate findings into campaign opportunities, not slide decks. Articulate strategy, rationale, channels, and expected outcomes in a plan a client can read. Build and maintain content calendars and campaign schedules. Advise on channel mix, sequencing, and budget allocation — and defend your reasoning.



02 — Execution. Set up, monitor, and optimise Google Ads — keyword research, ad copy, audience targeting, bid management. Implement and manage SEO programs — technical audits, on-page optimisation, content briefs, link building. Manage social media accounts — organic posting, community engagement, and paid execution across Meta and LinkedIn. Track performance live and adjust based on data, not on quarterly reviews. Brief copy, creative, and design support when the campaign needs it, and hold the bar.



03 — Reporting & analytics. Build and maintain custom client reporting in Looker Studio. Produce monthly performance reports covering ROI, traffic, conversions, audience growth, and campaign metrics. Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush or Ahrefs, and Meta Ads Manager to inform strategy and validate results. Translate numbers into recommendations the client can act on. Flag what isn't working early and propose the change.



04 — Client engagement. Join discovery calls and ongoing client meetings alongside the agency director. Help prepare strategy presentations and campaign proposals for new and existing clients. Walk clients through progress, insights, and recommendations — clearly, in writing and on video. Handle questions and pushback without losing the room. Be the trusted face of the agency on the campaigns you run.





What we're looking for



We're hiring for strategic judgement, execution discipline, and client poise — not a rigid checklist. If most of the below describes you, please apply.



Essential



5+ years hands-on digital marketing experience, preferably in an agency managing multiple client accounts.



Excellent spoken and written English — you'll be on video calls with Australian SME owners and senior marketers, presenting strategy and walking through results.



Proven ability to plan and execute integrated campaigns across SEO, Google Ads, and social (paid and organic).



Strong working knowledge of: Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, SEMrush or Ahrefs, Meta Ads Manager, and social scheduling tools.



Track record of building campaign plans that articulate strategy, rationale, channels, and expected outcomes.



Experience translating competitor analysis into actionable campaign moves.



Self-motivated and able to work independently without close supervision.



Reliable home internet and a dedicated, professional home workspace.



Nice to have (not required)



Marketing copywriting — taglines, calls to action, ad copy, social captions.



Familiarity with WordPress for blog posting and basic content updates.



Canva or similar for social media graphics.



 marketing platforms and campaign execution.



Meta advertising compliance, including 18+ ad categories.



Comfort contributing to client-facing meetings and presenting strategy.



Out of scope



Graphic design specialism — the agency has a design team.



Sales and new-business development — the agency director handles client acquisition.



Production-level web development — handled by the build team.





Who you are



You're a strategist who also ships. You can sit on a discovery call with an Australian SME owner, draw the goal out of them, and walk out with a campaign plan you can defend. You like the discipline of Looker Studio more than the noise of vanity metrics. You're comfortable on camera — you can hold the room when a client pushes back, concede what should be conceded, and defend what shouldn't. And you'd rather have a long-term seat at a respected agency than bounce between freelance gigs.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you.





How it works



1. Application review. We assess your resume, portfolio, and answers against the brief. Strong fits move to interview.

2. Interview. A 45-minute video interview with the agency director. We discuss your background, your campaigns, how you work with clients, and how you think about strategy.

3. Paid trial. The strongest candidate is offered a paid initial trial on a probationary basis.





How to Apply



Apply directly via OJP. Attach:



1. Your resume (PDF).

2. Work samples / portfolio — link or PDF. We want to see real campaign work you've run: campaign plans, Looker Studio reports, ad creative, post-campaign write-ups. One strong case study beats a long list.



In your application message, answer these three questions. Short, direct answers — no AI fluff.



1. One campaign, end-to-end. Pick one campaign you owned. Business goal, channel mix (SEO / Google Ads / paid social / organic), what you measured, what the data told you mid-flight, what you changed, and what the campaign actually delivered. 8–12 lines.



2. Client pushback. You're on a video call with an Australian SME owner who disagrees with a recommendation you believe is right. Walk us through a real example — how you held the room, what you conceded, and what you defended.



3. Logistics. Expected full-time monthly salary in PHP, earliest start date, home internet speed, and confirm you can work Melbourne business hours (Mon–Fri).



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Growth Marketing & Sales Specialist — SEO, Ads & Lead Conversion (Australian Service Business)

Full-time. You set your own focus time, but you must be reachable during Brisbane business hours (7-4) for fast lead response (speed wins bookings).



Pay:

Pay & growth path

We start low and pay you up fast as you prove results — no commission, just a rising wage tied to clear milestones.



Starting: AUD $900/month (3-month trial)

Rising to $1,100 ? $1,300 ? $1,500+/month as you hit agreed targets (leads, bookings, ROAS)

3. Your expected monthly rate



Applications without the case studies and the Loom won't be considered.

title: Creative Strategist & Content Producer
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.

Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist & Content Producer to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist & Content Producer will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

 templates

- Reliable internet (10+ Mbps), quiet workspace, USB headset

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant to CEO & Medical Director



Casa Privée | Miami Stem Cell Clinic | Institute of Regenerative Medicine & Neuroscience

Location: Brickell, Miami, FL

Type: Full-Time, In-Person

Schedule: Primarily Monday–Friday, with required flexibility for occasional evening and weekend responsiveness

Work Setting: Private clinical, regenerative medicine, concierge medical, executive education, and high-touch client-service environment



About Us



Casa Privée, Miami Stem Cell Clinic, and the Institute of Regenerative Medicine & Neuroscience operate at the intersection of private medicine, regenerative medicine, neuroscience, peptide science, executive education, and premium client service. The organizations are physician-led and built around discretion, precision, confidentiality, clinical excellence, and highly personalized care.



We are seeking an exceptional Executive Assistant to support the CEO & Medical Director, Prof. Dr. Bankole A. Johnson, and to help coordinate the daily administrative, clinical, client-facing, business-development, and selected personal support activities of a fast-moving, high-level medical and education platform.



This is not a routine administrative role. The ideal candidate must be intelligent, highly organized, discreet, responsive, polished, and able to operate in a demanding environment where priorities can change quickly.



Position Summary



The Executive Assistant will serve as a trusted administrative, operational, and personal support partner to the CEO & Medical Director. This person will manage scheduling, communications, document preparation, client coordination, vendor follow-up, internal task tracking, business-development support, and selected personal executive support for Prof. Dr. Bankole Johnson and Mrs. Elena Johnson.



The successful candidate must be comfortable working with confidential information, communicating with high-level clients and partners, coordinating across clinical and business teams, assisting with personal and family logistics when needed, and responding to important matters outside standard office hours, including evenings and weekends when necessary.



This role requires discretion, good judgment, initiative, accuracy, emotional intelligence, and the ability to move smoothly between executive office duties, client-facing communication, clinical-administrative support, and selected personal assistant responsibilities.



Key Responsibilities

Executive Support



Manage the CEO’s calendar, appointments, meetings, calls, reminders, and daily priorities.



Prepare, organize, and follow up on
s, letters, agreements, client communications, clinical program documents, reports, presentations, forms, and business materials.



Track tasks, deadlines, follow-ups, pending decisions, and priority projects.



Assist with travel coordination, meeting preparation, reservations, event planning, special arrangements, and executive logistics.



Maintain organized electronic and physical files, including contracts, order forms, client materials, protocols, correspondence, vendor documents, and internal records.



Ensure that the CEO is properly briefed before meetings, calls, client discussions, vendor interactions, and partner communications.



Protect the CEO’s time by helping prioritize communications, appointments, follow-ups, and operational matters.



Personal Executive Support for Prof. Dr. Johnson and Mrs. Elena Johnson



In addition to business and clinical administrative support, the Executive Assistant will provide selected personal executive assistance to Prof. Dr. Bankole Johnson and Mrs. Elena Johnson. This support is intended to reduce administrative burden, protect time, and ensure that important personal, family, household, and logistical commitments are organized with the same discretion and professionalism expected in the executive office.



Responsibilities may include coordinating personal calendars, appointments, reminders, reservations, travel plans, transportation, restaurant bookings, household appointments, deliveries, vendor scheduling, errands, family commitments, and other reasonable personal logistics.



The Executive Assistant may also assist with personal documents, correspondence, invitations, events, special occasions, gifts, household service providers, building staff, contractors, drivers, restaurants, hotels, and other personal contacts as directed.



The role requires strict confidentiality regarding all personal, family, financial, household, medical, travel, and private matters involving Prof. Dr. Johnson, Mrs. Elena Johnson, and their family.



The successful candidate must exercise excellent judgment, warmth, discretion, and professionalism when handling personal matters, especially where business, family, and private-client obligations overlap.



Reasonable evening or weekend responsiveness may be required for urgent personal, family, travel, household, or logistical matters where timing is important.



Client and Patient Coordination



Communicate professionally with clients, families, physicians, referral sources, vendors, and business partners.



Assist with scheduling consultations, follow-up calls, treatment-related communications, client onboarding, and confidential record coordination.



Ensure all client and patient communications are handled with warmth, accuracy, urgency, and discretion.



Help coordinate international client and physician communications when needed.



Maintain careful confidentiality regarding all client, patient, family, business, and proprietary matters.



Clinical and Administrative Operations



Support coordination between the CEO, clinic staff, operations team, outside vendors, physicians, consultants, and professional partners.



Help track orders, forms, treatment documents, protocols, client files, invoices, payments, vendor communications, and operational tasks.



Assist with preparation of professional letters, contracts, reports, brochures, programs, offer letters, order forms, and internal documents.



Support front-office and back-office flow when needed, including appointment coordination, file preparation, follow-up reminders, and client communication.



Help ensure that important documents are properly named, filed, updated, and retrievable.



Business Development and IRMN Support



Assist with outreach, follow-up, and coordination for IRMN educational programs, physician training, conferences, membership activities, licensing opportunities, and professional relationships.



Support communications with marketing, web, design, vendor, technology, and business-development teams.



Assist with tracking leads, referrals, prospective clients, physician contacts, partner opportunities, philanthropic contacts, and strategic relationships.



Support preparation of polished materials for high-level clients, doctors, investors, referral partners, and international contacts.



Help coordinate professional events, private meetings, visiting clients, physician discussions, and selected conference or training logistics.



Communication and Responsiveness



Monitor and respond to important communications in a timely and professional manner.



Draft and edit
s, letters, messages, internal updates, follow-up notes, and professional correspondence.



Use a polished, discreet, and appropriate tone in all written and verbal communication.



Escalate urgent matters quickly and appropriately.



Be available for reasonable weekend or after-hours responsiveness when important executive, client, family, clinical, vendor, travel, or operational matters require attention.



This does not mean constant weekend work, but it does require reliability, judgment, and timely response when important issues arise.



Confidentiality and Professional Conduct



Maintain strict confidentiality regarding clients, patients, physicians, business partners, family matters, pricing, protocols, intellectual property, clinical materials, personal information, financial information, and internal strategy.



Handle sensitive medical, business, and personal information with maturity and discretion.



Comply with all Company policies relating to privacy, confidentiality, data security, professional conduct, and appropriate communication.



Represent the organizations with professionalism, warmth, calmness, and discretion at all times.



Required Qualifications



Prior experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Office Manager, Client Coordinator, Concierge Coordinator, Medical Office Assistant, Legal Assistant, or similar high-responsibility support role.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel, Google Workspace, PDF handling, file organization, calendar systems, and online communication tools.



Excellent calendar management, task tracking, and follow-up skills.



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.



Ability to manage confidential and sensitive information with absolute discretion.



Ability to multitask without losing accuracy.



Strong judgment, emotional intelligence, and professional maturity.



Professional appearance, polished communication style, and calm demeanor.



Reliable transportation and ability to work in person in Brickell, Miami.



Flexibility to respond during evenings or weekends when important matters require attention.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience in a private medical practice, concierge medicine, regenerative medicine, wellness clinic, legal office, executive office, luxury hospitality, high-end client services, or healthcare administration.



Experience supporting a CEO, physician, founder, entrepreneur, or senior executive.



Familiarity with HIPAA, confidential records, medical scheduling, client intake, or clinical office procedures.



Experience preparing professional letters, contracts, reports, protocols, brochures, presentations, or business-development materials.



Comfort with high-level client communication and international contacts.



Ability to assist with marketing follow-up, social media coordination, presentations, events, or business-development tracking.



Spanish, Russian, Portuguese, or another international language is a plus but not required.



Ideal Candidate Profile



We are looking for someone who is:



Highly organized

Discreet and trustworthy

Fast but careful

Polished and professional

Emotionally intelligent

Able to anticipate needs

Comfortable with demanding standards

Responsive without becoming overwhelmed

Able to protect the CEO’s time and priorities

Warm with clients but firm with boundaries

Able to handle both business and personal matters appropriately

Interested in growing with a serious medical and business platform



The ideal candidate takes pride in keeping an executive office organized and functioning smoothly. They do not need constant supervision, follow through reliably, and understand that details matter.



Work Location



Primary work location:



Casa Privée / Miami Stem Cell Clinic / IRMN

1395 Brickell Avenue, Suite 200

Miami, Florida 33131



Some local errands, meetings, vendor coordination, client support, event support, or household-related logistics in the Miami area may occasionally be required.



Schedule



This is a full-time, in-person position in Brickell, Miami. The regular schedule is expected to be primarily Monday through Friday, but the role requires reasonable flexibility for urgent matters, special events, client needs, travel issues, personal logistics, and weekend responsiveness.



Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience, skill level, availability, professionalism, and fit for the role.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Resume

Brief cover note explaining why you are suited for a high-level executive assistant role

Availability and preferred start date

References, if available



Candidates should be prepared to discuss prior experience with scheduling, executive support, confidential information, client communication, personal assistance, document preparation, and evening or weekend responsiveness.



Only candidates who demonstrate strong communication, discretion, organization, reliability, and professionalism will be considered.

- You're a problem solver, meaning your role responsibility is to take work off our hands so we're not bothered not constantly bother us for every little thing - so you need to “own” yourself



Qualifications (Preferred)



- Experience using project management tools (Clickup or Notion)

- You are comfortable speaking and listening to people from all over the world

- You are competent and organized with remote work and systems. (Slack, Zoom, G Drive, etc)

- You have experience working with professionals/experts in a B2B environment.  You are on time, present yourself professionally, and carry yourself with high standards.

- You enjoy working in a proactive and detailed way.  You like to be ahead of due dates and you don’t like leaving “open loops”)

- You want to ask questions, be coached/critiqued, and developed.



Why You Might Enjoy This Role



- We will always find a way for you to grow more and earn more. We genuinely want to struggle to replicate you because you have become that great.

- Outside of standard SOPs and “To-Dos,” - we encourage feedback, input, and insight. The goal is for you to come up with better ideas than us, it means you’re the right fit. Creation is one of the best forms of contribution.

- Work remotely (Just have good internet, a nice camera, and a clean background)

- We have SOPs on every single process, and we will train you on everything

- Most of all a go-getter who wants an opportunity to grow into management roles as the agency grows.





Let's talk about time expectations:



The hours can vary but you can expect 20-30 hours/week. This will generally be between 9 am and 5 pm EST



From time to time, we have tasks or issues that require immediate resolution so, we would expect additional availability till 5pm EST, and possibly some weekends as needed. We will do our best to get you what you need ahead of time, but it's important that you can be flexible.



Very important to note that this is a check-in every day as the role is very dynamic, not something that is scheduled in advance and runs automatically.



Now, let's talk about the awesome stuff:



- We have one policy. If you do the right thing by us, we will do the right thing by you.

- We are also super family-first and we will do our absolute best to work around your requirements. We understand that life can get in the way. All we ask is that you don't take advantage of this

- We will always trust you until you give us a reason not to

- You will never get in trouble or reprimanded if you make a mistake, as long as you have our best interest at heart and you thought it was the right decision

- We actively encourage input. The worst case is we have a team of people who are too afraid to speak their piece

- We are also super transparent. If we are happy, you will know, if we are not, you will also know

- We are a fun, positive, growing team. We love to support each other in our individual roles. We're like a virtual family.

- Opportunity to make a real difference. We aren't just churning and burning through clients, we want all of our team to be super proud of where they work and the people they work for





Here's what we expect from you:



- As this is a remote position where we will be transferring large files back and forth, fast & reliable internet is a must.

- Nothing is ever a big enough problem that can't be fixed if we are made aware of it. Disappearing if something goes wrong is a big no-no

- You love getting things done. You love to keep your project management board up to date and have high-touch communication, you can let us know what you need, stay on top of your tasks, and update us on tasks completed without us having to track you down for answers.

- You're a self-starter, problem-solver, and are reliable. You can juggle lots of moving pieces, and know how to focus and execute!

- You're good with engaging people. Part of this role will be working with several stakeholders, so your ability to communicate concepts and ideas will be critical

- You love having full ownership over the process. You're constantly seeking to improve projects asking yourself what's working and how you can make your role better.

- You have a high attention to detail, you're careful to stay on brand and avoid typos, etc. without getting caught up in perfectionism.

- You appreciate and value feedback and can handle direct (and blunt) feedback along the way for continuous improvement.



Application Details:



- We will likely get 100+ applications for this role and we simply don't have time to interview that many candidates, so make this stand out if you want a job that will change the entire trajectory of your life.

- We require a 2-3 minute loom video along with your application. Candidates WITHOUT the video won't be accepted. If you don't feel comfortable you can have your camera off.

- The video can include your past work experience, why you are a good fit for the role etc

- We are looking to bring our new colleague on board as soon as possible, but we will spend the necessary time to find the best fit both in abilities and culture.

- Please include the word "Secret" in the final question of this application to show us your attention to detail. Applications are reviewed on a first-come, first-served basis for interviews.

title: Design Operations Specialist (Production Designer)
description:
Design Operations Specialist (Production Designer)



The short version

We're not looking for an artist. AI tools now handle a lot of the "make it look good" work. We're looking for someone who can own the design process end-to-end — take a brief, run with it, talk to suppliers directly, get production-ready files out the door, and not need to be chased or supervised at every step.

If you read a request and your instinct is "got it, I'll handle it and come back when it's done" — keep reading. If your instinct is to send it back for approval before acting, this isn't the role.



What you'll actually do



Take creative direction and turn it into production-ready artwork and assets across multiple product lines (printed, laser-cut, packaging, catalogues, product mockups).

Drive AI design tools (e.g. Recraft and GPT) confidently — using them as your primary production engine, not as a novelty.

Prepare and check files against manufacturing specs (print-ready files, DXF / cut files, dimensions, bleed, colour) and catch errors before they reach a supplier.

Own supplier and client communication on artwork. When a supplier asks a question, you answer it directly and close the loop — you don't bounce it back up the chain.

Manage the workflow: track what's in progress, what's waiting, what's done, and keep things moving without being prompted.

Spot problems early and solve them, or flag them clearly with a recommended fix.



Who you are



You take ownership. "Please send this to the supplier" means you send it and handle their reply — not that you send it back to us first.

You're analytical and detail-tight. You don't make the same mistake twice, and you check your own work before it goes out.

You're comfortable with ambiguity. You ask sharp clarifying questions up front, then execute — you don't need hand-holding through every step.

You're fluent (or fast-learning) with AI design tools and genuinely excited about working this way.

You communicate clearly in writing — concise, complete, and proactive. No one-word replies that leave us guessing.



What matters more than a fine-art degree

A background in production, manufacturing, retail operations, or project/product workflow management is more valuable to us than a traditional graphic design or fine-art portfolio. We want systems thinking applied to design — someone who sees the whole pipeline, not just the pretty picture.

Strong technical execution still matters (clean, accurate, professional output), but raw artistic flair is the least important thing on this list.



How to apply

Send your portfolio and a short answer to these two questions:



Describe a time you were given an unclear or incomplete brief. What did you do?



A supplier replies to artwork you sent with a technical question you're not 100% sure how to answer. Walk us through exactly what you do next.



We read the answers to these before we look at anything else.

title: Order Management & Supplier Operations VA – Shopify Ecommerce (Remote, Long-Term)

ABOUT THE ROLE

We run several growing Shopify dropshipping stores. Every day there are open orders that need follow-up — supplier delays, address issues, refunds, missing tracking. We need someone who owns that pipeline end-to-end so nothing slips.

You will not be left guessing. From day one you get SOPs, ready-made

 suppliers to resolve fulfillment issues: out of stock, delays, wrong addresses, returns

This role is 7 days a week, 4–6 hours per day. Orders come in every day, including weekends, and they need to be handled every day. If you cannot commit to working 7 days a week, please do not apply — we will not make exceptions, and applying anyway only wastes both our time.

title: [HIRING] Full-Time Research & Data VA for B2B Sales Operation (Long-term Seat)
description:
[HIRING] Full-Time Research & Data VA for B2B Sales Operation (Long-Term Seat)



This is a long-term seat for someone who wants to own the data layer of a growing sales operation. I run outbound for two B2B software accounts and need a sharp, detail-obsessed VA to keep my prospect data clean and my call and
 lists ready to go. This is a research and data role, not a sending or copywriting role. I handle all outreach myself. You make sure what I'm working from is accurate.



THE TWO ACCOUNTS YOU'LL SUPPORT



Account 1 is an AI customer-service chat platform. We target customer experience and support leaders at companies still running an outdated rules-based chatbot or no chatbot at all. A big part of your job is checking prospect websites to classify exactly that. Companies running a modern AI chat platform are disqualified.



Account 2 is a quality and compliance software company. We target quality, operations, and supply chain leaders at industrial manufacturers in the US. Your job here is building and verifying clean contact lists of the right people at the right companies.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Website qualification (Account 1). Check prospect websites and classify whether they're running no chatbot, a basic rules-based chatbot, or a modern AI chat platform. This is the most important task. Accuracy matters more than speed.



2. List building and enrichment in Apollo and Prospeo (both accounts). Source and verify contacts to a defined spec. Hard rule: direct dials and mobile numbers only, never company HQ or main lines. If only a main number exists, leave the phone field blank.



3. Data hygiene in HubSpot and Google Sheets (both accounts). Dedupe records, fill missing fields, standardize titles and formatting, flag stale contacts.



4. Contact verification. Confirm target lists against the ICP before a contact gets marked call-ready.



This role grows. As you prove yourself, it expands into more ownership of the data process and potentially managing a second hire. I'm hiring one person and keeping them.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



Real, hands-on experience with LinkedIn, Apollo, Prospeo, HubSpot, and Google Sheets. Tell me specifically what you've done in each. Excellent written English and obsessive attention to detail. The judgment to make accurate calls on ambiguous data without hand-holding. Reliable full-time availability, 40 hours per week. US timezone overlap required.



PAY AND LOGISTICS



$9 to $13 per hour, depending on experience, paid weekly or biweekly via Wise. Full-time, 40 hours per week. Strong performers get raises, not promises.



TO APPLY



Answer this before anything else: how would you determine whether a website is running an AI-powered chatbot versus a basic rules-based one? Walk me through what you'd actually look for. Applications without an answer to that question will not be reviewed. 



This role requires independent judgment so generic AI-generated responses are easy to spot and will be disqualified. Include your rate within the range and your available start date. If you have a Linkedin account, please share the link.

title: Real Estate AI Post Production Editor/ Operator
description:
This is not a traditional photo editing job.



We are hiring a Real Estate AI Post Production Editor/ Operator to help run, manage, and improve our real estate photo editing workflow.



Most of this role involves bulk processing real estate photos through an AI editing system, reviewing the output, and quickly making the corrections needed before delivery. You will be responsible for making sure our final images look clean, accurate, professional, and distraction-free.



This role requires speed, strong visual judgment, attention to detail, reliable communication, and the ability to work efficiently through large batches of photos.



The goal is not to slowly over-edit every image. The goal is to quickly identify what matters, fix the important issues, and move on to the next photo.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your main responsibility will be taking AI-edited real estate photos and preparing them for final delivery.



This includes:



* Bulk processing real estate photos through our AI editing workflow

* Reviewing AI-edited images for quality, accuracy, and consistency

* Fixing verticals, horizontals, and perspective issues

* Correcting wall colors, floor colors, cabinets, ceilings, and finishes

* Removing distractions using Photoshop tools such as Generative Fill, healing, cloning, and cleanup tools

* Removing or fixing items such as cords, clutter, trash cans, cars, people, pets, signs, reflections, wires, small messes, and other distractions

* Making cropping decisions when it improves the composition

* Comparing edited images to originals to make sure the final result is accurate

* Preparing final galleries for delivery

* Communicating clearly when there are issues, questions, or recurring problems

* Helping identify ways to improve our editing workflow over time



A big part of this job is being able to quickly look at a photo, notice what is distracting, fix it cleanly, and keep moving.



Additional Responsibilities



In addition to standard real estate photo editing, you may also:



* Manage AI workflows for virtual staging orders

* Review virtually staged images for realism, scale, placement, and quality

* Prepare virtually staged images for final delivery

* Edit RAW files for specialized design, architectural, or interior photography projects

* Edit twilight photos when needed

* Help improve our systems, checklists, and quality control process over time



What Good Work Looks Like



Good work in this role means:



* Verticals are straight

* Perspective feels natural

* Walls look accurate and not color-shifted

* Floors, cabinets, ceilings, and finishes look realistic

* Images feel clean, bright, professional, and natural

* Distracting objects are removed when appropriate

* Cleanup work is not obvious

* Cropping improves the photo without cutting off important features

* Virtual staging looks realistic and believable

* The edit does not feel fake, overdone, or artificial

* The final gallery feels consistent from image to image

* You work quickly without becoming careless

* You remember feedback and apply it to future jobs



We need someone who can make good judgment calls without needing every small decision explained.



Work Schedule



* Tuesday – Saturday

* 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM Eastern Time

* Full-time availability required

* Real-time communication during U.S. business hours is required



You must be available, responsive, and actively working during the scheduled hours.



Who We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



* Has strong experience with Photoshop and/or Lightroom

* Is comfortable using AI editing tools and learning new workflows

* Can work quickly through large batches of images

* Has a strong eye for distractions, color problems, perspective issues, and composition

* Understands that real estate photos should look clean, bright, natural, and accurate

* Can identify what is distracting in a photo and fix it efficiently

* Can make good judgment calls without needing constant direction

* Takes ownership of their work

* Learns from feedback and applies it consistently

* Communicates clearly and proactively

* Notices recurring problems and brings them up instead of ignoring them

* Is reliable, consistent, and looking for a long-term role



This Role Is Not a Good Fit If



This role is probably not a good fit if you:



* Prefer slow, highly detailed creative retouching

* Need a lot of direction on every image

* Struggle to work quickly

* Miss the same issues after they have been pointed out

* Have unreliable or slow internet

* Are not comfortable working during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

* Have difficulty understanding detailed written English instructions

* Only want occasional freelance projects



Required Skills



* Experience editing photos in Lightroom, Photoshop, or similar tools

* Ability to correct perspective and straighten verticals

* Ability to correct color issues, especially walls, floors, cabinets, ceilings, and finishes

* Experience with Photoshop cleanup tools such as Generative Fill, healing, cloning, content-aware fill, or object removal

* Ability to quickly identify distractions in real estate photos

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to work efficiently through high-volume photo batches

* Strong written English comprehension

* Reliable computer and stable high-speed internet connection



Preferred:



* Experience editing real estate photography

* Experience with AI photo editing tools

* Experience with virtual staging workflows

* Experience editing RAW files

* Experience editing twilight photos

* Experience with architectural, interior, or design photography

* Experience with high-volume production editing or quality control



Technical & Internet Requirements



This role requires downloading and uploading large real estate photo sets every workday.



Some days may involve transferring 10–20+ GB of photos. Because of this, slow or unreliable internet will make it impossible to perform the job successfully.



Required:



* Stable high-speed internet connection

* Minimum 100 Mbps download speed

* Minimum 25 Mbps upload speed

* Ability to download and upload large photo galleries throughout the workday

* Reliable computer capable of handling large photo batches

* Sufficient storage space for large working files

* Photoshop and/or Lightroom access and experience

* Backup internet plan strongly preferred



Preferred:



* 200+ Mbps download speed

* 50+ Mbps upload speed

* Ethernet connection instead of Wi-Fi

* Low ping

* Backup internet through a second provider, mobile hotspot, or coworking location

* Computer with strong processor, 16GB+ RAM, SSD storage, and enough available storage for large photo jobs



When applying, please include:



* Screenshot of a recent internet speed test

* Download speed

* Upload speed

* Ping

* Whether you use Wi-Fi or Ethernet

* Your backup internet plan if your main connection goes down

* Computer specs, including processor, RAM, storage type, and available storage space



Communication Requirements



Strong written English comprehension is required.



Perfect grammar is not required, but you must be able to:



* Understand detailed written instructions

* Ask clear questions when something is unclear

* Explain problems accurately

* Communicate about nuanced editing issues

* Apply feedback after it is given



This role requires real-time communication during the workday.



Compensation



$10/hr

Full-time role

Long-term opportunity



Growth Potential



This role has strong long-term potential.



The right person can grow into:



* Workflow management

* Training other editors

* Leading the post-production team

* Managing AI editing systems

* Improving quality control standards

* Helping build and manage the post-production department



We are building a system, and the right person can become a key part of it.



How to Apply



Please include answers to the following:



1. Tell us about yourself and your photo editing experience.

2. What experience do you have with Lightroom, Photoshop, Generative Fill, or similar tools?

3. Have you edited real estate photos before? If yes, describe your experience.

4. Have you worked with AI photo editing tools before? If yes, which ones?

5. When reviewing a real estate photo, what distractions or issues would you look for first?

6. How do you d
 what should be removed from a photo and what should stay?

7. What does “natural but clean” mean to you in real estate photo editing?

8. Describe your process for correcting perspective and vertical lines.

9. Describe your process for correcting inaccurate wall colors or color shifts.

10. Describe a time you received feedback on your work. What did you change afterward?

11. Describe a time you improved a process or solved a problem without being asked.

12. How do you balance speed and quality when working through a large batch of images?

13. What would you do if you noticed the AI editing system kept making the same mistake?

14. What would you do if your internet became slow or unstable during work hours?

15. This role may require downloading and uploading 10–20+ GB of photos in a single day. Please explain your internet setup and confirm that your connection can reliably handle this.

16. What is your computer setup? Please include processor, RAM, storage type, available storage space, and editing software.

17. Please include a screenshot of a recent internet speed test.

18. Confirm your availability for Tuesday – Saturday, 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM Eastern Time.





We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us, take pride in their work, and be part of a team that values quality, consistency, speed, and improvement.



If you are detail-oriented, reliable, fast, and interested in helping build a better post-production system, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Remote Loan Processor
description:
About Elite Processing Team



Elite Processing Team is a fast-growing U.S.-based mortgage processing company dedicated to serving mortgage brokers and loan officers nationwide. Our team specializes in processing residential mortgage loans from submission to funding — with a relentless focus on speed, accuracy, and compliance.



We work directly in the wholesale lending channel — partnering with top lenders including UWM, NewRez/Shellpoint, PennyMac, A&D Mortgage, Rocket Pro TPO, Freedom Mortgage, Plaza Home Mortgage, and others. We are building a world-class remote processing team in the Philippines to extend our capacity and deliver a seamless 24-hour processing cycle for our U.S. lending partners.



This is not a back-office data entry role. We are looking for seasoned, independent mortgage processors who can own a file from Day 1 and take it all the way to funding with minimal hand-holding.



POSITION DETAILS



Job Title Mortgage Loan Processor — Remote

Location 100% Remote / Work From Home — Philippines

Employment Type Full-Time  |  Contract positions also available

Work Schedule U.S. Business Hours (EST/CST/PST overlap required)

Hourly Rate $4-6/hour (USD equivalent)  |  Based on experience

Reports To Deepa Patel -- Director of Operations

HR Contact Amul Patel — HR Director

Start Date Immediate openings — rolling start dates available



What You Will Do



As a Remote Mortgage Processor at Elite Processing Team, you will independently manage a pipeline of active loan files for U.S. mortgage brokers. You will be the central point of contact between the loan officer, borrower, underwriter, title company, and lender — keeping every file moving on schedule toward a 15-business-day Clear to Close.



Daily Responsibilities

? Manage an active pipeline of 30–50 residential mortgage files simultaneously

? Review new loan submissions: 1003, credit report, AUS findings (DU/LP), and all initial documents

? Order and track all third-party services: appraisal, title, flood certification, HOI, VOE, condo documents, payoffs,etc

? Conduct full income analysis — W-2, self-employed, rental income, pension, SSI, commission

? Review asset statements: source, season, and document all large deposits per agency guidelines

? Build complete underwriting packages and submit directly to lender portals (UWM TRAC, POWER+, NewRez, A&D, etc.)

? Read and interpret AUS findings (DU/LP) — identify all PTD, PTC, and PTF conditions

? Clear all underwriter conditions with written LOEs, updated documents, and third-party verifications

? Manage TRID compliance: issue Loan Estimates and coordinate Closing Disclosure delivery within regulatory timelines

? Coordinate Clear to Close with title/escrow, confirm cash-to-close figures, and schedule signing

? Communicate proactively with LOs, borrowers, realtors, and settlement agents — daily updates required

? Maintain LOS with accurate milestone updates throughout the life of every file

? Perform post-close file review and upload trailing documents to lender portals within required timeframes



Lender & Platform Knowledge Required



You must have direct, hands-on experience processing loans in the wholesale channel. Retail bank or large institutional experience does not translate to what we do — we need processors who understand broker-to-lender workflows, lender-specific overlays, and portal-based submission.



Wholesale Lenders We Work With



? UWM (United Wholesale Mortgage) — TRAC portal

? NewRez / Shellpoint Mortgage

? PennyMac — POWER+ portal

? A&D Mortgage — DSCR & Non-QM specialist

? Rocket Pro TPO — Rocket Connect

? Freedom Mortgage — VA & FHA specialist

? Plaza Home Mortgage — renovation loans

? LoanStream Mortgage — Non-QM programs

? Any other wholesale/correspondent lender 



Experience We Do NOT Want

? Large retail banks: Wells Fargo, Chase, Citibank, Bank of America

? Big institution consumer lending or bank operations

? Call center / mass processing without file ownership

? Data entry roles without full-cycle processing experience

? Mortgage origination or sales (LO) experience only

? Processing experience limited to one loan type only

? Roles where someone else handled UW condition clearing

? Roles where you had no contact with borrowers or LOs



Required Qualifications



Loan Type Expertise  (All Required)

? FHA — MIP upfront/monthly, case numbers, overlays, manual UW

? VA — COE, entitlement, funding fee, IRRRL net tangible benefit

? Conventional — Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac DU/LP, PMI, overlays

? DSCR / Investor — DSCR ratio, rent rolls, lease agreements, no-ratio programs

? Non-QM — bank statement (12/24 mo), asset depletion, P&L only

? Jumbo — high-balance, non-conforming guidelines

? USDA Rural Housing — GUS AUS, income limits, guarantee fee

? Refinance — Rate/term, cash-out, FHA/VA streamline, HELOC 



Technical & System Skills

? LOS platforms: Encompass (ICE), BytePro, Calyx Point, or similar

? AUS: Desktop Underwriter (DU) and Loan Prospector (LP) — must be able to read and interpret findings

? Lender portals: UWM TRAC, POWER+, NewRez, A&D, or others

? Income analysis tools and VOE platforms

? DocuSign, DocMagic, or equivalent e-signature/doc tools

? Microsoft Office (Word/Excel) and Google Workspace

? TRID timelines: LE issuance, CD delivery, 3-business-day rule

? 4506-C, SSA-89, flood cert, title ordering — all vendor services





Experience Requirements

? Minimum 3 years of U.S. residential mortgage processing

? Must have processed loans end-to-end — submission through funding

? Must have direct experience clearing UW conditions independently

? Must have worked with multiple wholesale lenders (not just one)

? Must have experience with multiple loan types (not just Conventional)

? Must have managed your own pipeline without relying on a team lead for every decision 



Communication Standards

? Excellent written English — your
s and notes must be professional, clear, and concise

? Strong verbal English — daily calls with U.S.-based LOs, borrowers, and vendors

? Ability to explain complex conditions to non-industry borrowers simply and calmly

? Professional tone at all times — you represent Elite Processing Team on every interaction

? Proactive communicator — you do not wait to be asked for a status update

? Comfortable with video calls using Zoom, Teams, or Google Meet



What Elite Processing Team Offers



Compensation & Work Setup

? Competitive pay: $4-8/hour USD equivalent

? 100% remote — work from your home office

? Performance bonuses tied to file quality and cycle time

? Full-time hours with consistent, high-volume pipeline

? No slow seasons — steady loan volume year-round Growth & Culture

title: Short-Form Video Editor (CapCut) – Faceless Music Reels & TikToks

We're Blackwake Audio, a music label creating short-form content for our artists. We need a reliable part-time editor to turn our songs into faceless vertical clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. This is templated, repeatable work. Once you learn our style, it's fast.

What you'll do:



Edit short vertical videos (9:16, 1080×1920), 8–15 seconds each, from a brief we give you.

Each clip is a simple "vibe loop" background + on-screen caption text + a cut of our song, synced so the hook lands in the first second.

Source background loops from free stock sites (Pexels, Pixabay, Mixkit) or generate them with an AI video tool (Kling, Runway, or Luma — a plus, not required).

Place caption text exactly to our spec for font, size, and position. We provide a one-page style guide and reference clips.

Trim each clip into a seamless loop and export a ready-to-post file.

Deliver in batches, around 20–30 finished clips per week (we'll dial in the exact number during the trial).



What we provide:



The audio cuts, the exact caption text for every clip, and a style guide with examples. You're assembling and sourcing backgrounds, not writing copy or guessing the vibe.



You're a fit if you:



Are fluent in CapCut and fast at templated editing.

Have a sharp eye for clean, readable text and good timing.

Follow a spec precisely. Consistency and text placement matter a lot to us.

Are reliable, communicate clearly in English, and hit deadlines.

Have a portfolio of short-form, vertical, or faceless edits (lyric videos, POV edits, and similar).



Nice to have:



Experience with AI video generators (Kling, Runway, Luma, Sora).

A feel for music and short-form pacing.



Logistics:



Part-time, about 20 hours/week, long-term and ongoing for the right person.

Starts with a paid trial of 3–5 clips so we can both see if it's a fit.

You deliver finished files and will not need access to our social accounts.



To apply:



Start your message with the word "ECHO" so I know you read this.

Send 2–3 examples of faceless or vertical short-form videos you've edited.

Tell me which tools you use and how many simple clips you can turn around per hour.

You're naturally curious about technology and enjoy figuring out how things work. You're comfortable picking up new software/tools, you take initiative, and you bring a positive attitude to your work. • GitHub — version control, collaboration, managing repositories

• Cursor IDE — AI-assisted development environment

• Claude Co-work — advanced AI collaboration and agentic workflows

• Prompt Engineering — structuring AI instructions for consistent, high-quality outputs

• Systems Design — building scalable internal processes from scratch

REQUIREMENTS



Must Have

•  Strong computer literacy — comfortable navigating new software and figuring things out

• Experience with or willingness to quickly learn AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)

• Experience with spreadsheets (Excel, Google Sheets, or Airtable)

• Basic understanding of automation concepts (connecting tools, triggers, workflows)

ONBOARDING

 templates to work with.

title: Video Editing & Content Production Virtual Assistant
description:
Video Editing & Content Production Virtual Assistant - FOOT & LEG CENTRE



Full-Time · Remote · Long-Term · Based in the Philippines



Pay:        AUD $1,200 – $1,400 per month (full-time)



Hours:    Monday – Friday. 38 hours per week. Flexible Hours - ideally available 10:30am – 6:30pm ACST (Adelaide, South Australia)



Tools: CapCut (required) · Dropbox · Slack · Microsoft Office 365



Start date: As soon as the right person is found





  WHO WE ARE



Foot & Leg Centre is a special focused podiatry clinic based in Adelaide, South Australia — with two locations in Kent Town and Glenelg.



We specialise exclusively in Foot Mobilisation Therapy (FMT) — a hands-on, natural approach to treating foot and leg pain without orthotics, drugs, or surgery in most cases. We've helped over 21,000 people get their lives back. We're not a typical clinic and we don't produce typical content.



Our tagline: Changing feet. Changing lives.



Our content educates, builds trust, and helps people with foot problems find a real answer. We need someone who can help us produce that content consistently, professionally, and without needing to be chased.



  THE ROLE



This is a full-time, long-term video editing and content production role. You will be the engine behind our social media content output — turning raw footage from our team into polished, on-brand long form and short-form videos for
, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.



This is a production and execution role. Not a strategy role. Not an influencer role. You follow clear briefs, apply our brand standards, and deliver consistently — without being chased.



If you're someone who takes ownership, communicates proactively, and finds satisfaction in doing excellent work inside a well-defined system — this role was built for you.



  WHAT YOU'LL DO



Core Responsibility — Video Editing (~80% of your time)

You will edit long-form and short-form videos from raw video footage using CapCut. 



Each edit includes:

- Clean cuts, jump cuts, and pacing that holds attention

- Relevant B-roll from clinic footage or approved stock libraries

- Accurate captions / subtitles in Australian English spelling

- Licence-compliant background music at appropriate levels

- Text overlays and hooks using our brand colours and fonts

- Logo placement and brand-consistent presentation

- Export at correct specs for each platform (Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, YouTube)

- File naming and storage in Dropbox following our naming convention



Content Repurposing

You will maximise every video by turning one core edit into multiple platform-ready outputs — Reels, Stories, Shorts, and static graphics — using our repurposing framework.



Thumbnails & Static Graphics

You will create Reel thumbnails, quote cards, educational static posts, carousel graphics, and 'Read Post Copy' graphics — all aligned to our brand guidelines.



Captions & Copy Formatting

You will format captions provided by Emily for each video in correct Australian English spelling — ready for scheduling. Where applicable you will include calls to action (CTA’s), hashtags and locations.





Reporting & Communication

- Weekly summary every Friday covering: videos edited, assets created, work in progress, anything at risk

- Maintain the video editing tracker spreadsheets

- Communicate proactively if a deadline is at risk or clarification is needed

- "No chasing required" is the standard — Emily should not need to follow up on your tasks



  WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



To be clear about scope — this role does not include marketing strategy, campaign ideation, copywriting from scratch, influencer-style content creation, ad management, or analytics reporting.



  WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required

- Strong video editing skills using CapCut — this is non-negotiable

- Experience producing short-form video content for social platforms (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts)

- Comfortable working with B-roll, subtitles, and licence-compliant background music

- High attention to detail — captions, file naming, brand consistency

- Reliable, proactive communication — you flag issues before they become problems

- Comfortable working independently within defined SOPs and checklists

- Available Full Time – 38hrs / week. Bulk of hours worked between 10:30am – 6:30pm ACST (Adelaide time), Monday to Friday with negotiated flexibility to suit you.





Highly Regarded

- Experience with other creative tools eg Chat GTP and Claude

- Canva or graphic design skills for thumbnails and static posts

- Experience working with healthcare, wellness, or education brands





  KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS



These are how we measure success in this role. Targets apply from Day 91 onwards — we allow a full 90-day on-ramp period.



KPI                   TARGET                            HOW IT's MEASURED

Video output          Minimum 10 videos/week          Video Recording and Editing Tracker and Slack

On-time delivery  100% by agreed deadlines          Video Recording and Editing Tracker and Slack

First-draft approval ? 90% approved within 2 rounds by Day 91    Video Recording and Editing Tracker and Slack

Editing Revisions  Completed with 24hrs                  Video Recording and Editing Tracker and Slack

Brand compliance  Zero unauthorised music or compliance breaches   Emily review at approval

Repurposing          Every core video produces ? 3 outputs  Counted per brief

Weekly report  Submitted every Friday           Slack message to Emily/Mike

File organisation  Dropbox audit-ready at all times         Spot checks by Emily/Mike







What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

- Minimum of 10 polished, on-brand videos delivered every week without prompting

- Revisions are rare — you've learned our style and apply it independently

- Emily and Mike are completely out of execution — they review and approve, nothing more

- You are a trusted, reliable part of the team



  AHPRA — IMPORTANT



Foot & Leg Centre is a registered healthcare provider in Australia. All content must comply with AHPRA advertising guidelines — this means no guaranteed outcomes, no cure claims, and careful language around clinical results. Full training is provided. This is a non-negotiable requirement of the role.



  HOW TO APPLY



We take applications seriously. Please read these instructions carefully — incomplete applications will not be considered.



1 Apply via our web form



If you think this role is for you submit your application here:





2 Paid test edit



Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed and asked to complete a skills test (Edit a raw short-form minute video clip to edit in CapCut and asked to produce a Reel (approximately 60-seconds in length). You will be paid AUD $25 for this regardless of outcome.





We are looking for a long-term tea
mber — not a contractor for a project. If you value stability, clear systems, and working with a small team that genuinely cares about what it produces, we'd love to hear from you.



Foot & Leg Centre  ·  Kent Town & Glenelg, Adelaide SA  ·  

© Medial Column Pty Ltd T/As Foot & Leg Centre

Most video editing jobs on this platform will ask you to edit a lot of videos, fast.



We're the opposite. We want you to edit fewer videos, better.



Our D2C brands spend real money on Meta ads (millions of impressions every month) and every cut you make gets tested against hard performance data. Hook rate, thumbstop, CTR, ROAS. The work is judged by whether it actually moves numbers, not whether it looked cool in review.



That means two things for you:

1) You'll get obsessive levels of feedback. A reviewer will tell you how to improve every video, every time. This happens constantly. If that sounds like hell, leave now. If it sounds like the best editing job you've ever had, keep reading.



2) You'll actually get good. Really good. Editors who stay with us for a year become the kind of editors who can't go back to generic freelance work because they've seen what performance-driven iteration does to their skills. 



We have tea
mbers who've been here 2+ years and they run things now.

- $
/month based on experience

- Paid vacation time 

- Paid PH holidays off (all of them!)  

- Weekends off 

 

Here's the honest part: 

You'll get a lot of feedback. Sometimes on cuts you thought were finished. The bar is high because our ads are seen by millions of people.



This isn't a side gig. Our work needs your focus, and if you're stitching this together with two other clients, we'll see it in the quality and we'll part ways fast. If you want a real seat at a real company, that's what we're offering.

You will bridge the gap between disparate systems—from CRMs and property management systems (PMS) to modern AI and automation tools—ensuring seamless data flow and operational efficiency. 



The ideal candidate is proficient in modern programming languages, has a strong grasp of database architecture, and possesses a passion for leveraging low-code automation platforms and cutting-edge AI technologies to solve complex business challenges.





Key Responsibilities



- API Development & Management: Design, build, and maintain scalable RESTful APIs and webhooks to facilitate communication between internal and external systems. 

- Systems Integration: Lead integration projects with third-party platforms, including CRMs, PMS solutions, and communication tools (Twilio, Vonage). 

- Automation & Workflow: Develop and maintain automated workflows using platforms like n8n, Make, Zapier, and the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) to streamline business processes. 

- Data Engineering & Reporting: Write complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data. Build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI to provide stakeholders with actionable insights. 

- Cloud & Infrastructure: Utilize Microsoft Azure services (including Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and App Services) to deploy and manage integration solutions. Leverage Microsoft Fabric for data integration and analytics where applicable. 

- AI & LLM Integration: Experiment with and implement solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) by integrating with OpenAI API, Azure AI, and other voice AI platforms (VAPI). 

- Code Maintenance: Write clean, maintainable code in Python or JavaScript/Node.js to support custom integration logic that goes beyond low-code capabilities.





Required Skills & Qualifications 



- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. 

- Programming: Proficiency in at least one modern language: Python or JavaScript/Node.js. 

- Database: Strong working knowledge of SQL for querying, data manipulation, and performance optimization. 

- Cloud: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services (Functions, Logic Apps, Storage). 

- Reporting: Proven experience building reports and dashboards in Power BI. 

- Integration Logic: Deep understanding of webhooks, event-driven architecture, and API security protocols (OAuth, API Keys).





Preferred Experience 



- Automation Platforms: Experience building workflows with n8n, Zapier, Make (Integromat). 

- Microsoft Stack: Proficiency with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate/Flow, Power Apps) and Microsoft Fabric. 

- AI & Voice: Experience integrating with Voice AI platforms (VAPI, Twilio, Vonage) or AI/LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure AI). 

- Domain Expertise: Previous experience integrating with Property Management Systems (PMS) or CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics 365). 

- Azure Advanced: Experience developing with Azure Apps and navigating the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.





Benefits:



- Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

- Complete PC package

- Comprehensive benefits package, including health and life insurance.

- Flexible work environment with the option to work remotely.

- Opportunities for professional growth and development.

- Collaborative and supportive team culture
